text:
Banks bloom bright along the river's calm flow.  
Ripples run red under a rising sun.  
Inhale the fresh air, a new day has come.  
Grasses greet the morning with gentle sway.  
Hills hold a city still wrapped in silence.  
Tall trees touch the sky where clouds float far.

Fog curls through the autumn forest at dawn.  
Rustling leaves dance in the crisp morning air.  
Oaks stand tall with golden crowns aglow.  
Shadows stretch long under the gray sky.  
Twigs snap softly as foxes prowl the woods.  
Yellow light filters down on fallen leaves.

Frosty winds howl hard through the mountain town.  
Rugged trails lead to quiet, snow-laden peaks.  
Oaks stand still, cloaked in a city of white.  
Glistening icicles hang from every hard edge.

Fierce winds fast blow along the rocky shore.  
Raging waves roll in, shaking all they touch.  
Ominous clouds o'ershadow the open bay.  
Gulls glide slowly, stays calm in the gale.

Woods glow warm in the fading light.  
I walk through trails that twist and turn.  
Nestled leaves rustle with a soft sound.  
Dusk brings stillness to this quiet night.

Winding roads glow with soft lamplight.  
In the hush, whispers of storm drift low.  
Night cloaks the city in calm shadow.  
Distant sounds hint at that hidden life.

Cold winds walk across small paths in the forest.  
Low golden light falls on brown and gold leaves.  
Odd shapes of trees hold shadows in the soft light.  
Underfoot, dry leaves make a soft, crisp sound.  
Distant sounds come from a quiet, small city.

Fierce gusts swept along the rugged shoreline.  
Raging waves crashed against the weathered rocks.  
Ominous clouds rolled in from the open ocean.  
Strong winds howled through the narrow coastal paths.  
Thunder rumbled as the storm moved steadily ashore.  
Yellow lights flickered in the darkness of the night.

Whispers of cold wrap around the slumbering town.  
Icicles hang from rooftops, sharp and still.  
Narrow lanes show autumn's last, fleeting gift.  
Dormant chimneys sit beside snow's soft drifts.

Hushed lights line narrow lanes in calm, cold air.  
Inky sky holds stars that glow with soft, warm rays.  
Lamps glow low, linking lonely lanes with lighted paths.  
Lingering sounds stays calm, cold, and full of hush.

Mighty waves crashed along the rocky shore.  
Ocean spray soaked everything in its path.  
Ugly clouds rolled in from the distant horizon.  
Thunder growled as dusk settled over the land.  
Hurricane wind howled through the empty streets.

I walk through the golden quiet path.  
Soft leaves fall in a slow dance.  
Lush colors mark the cool air.  
Autumn sun casts a warm glow.  
No birds sing but the wind hums.  
Dew rests on the silent ground.

Snowflakes settled silently on the slumbering summit.  
Pine branches bowed low under the thickening drifts.  
Rustic cabins welcomed warm glows from glowing fires.  
Icicles hung like crystals from crooked rooftops.  
Nights brought hush and stars in a black velvet sky.  
Gentle winds whispered through the frozen mountain night.

Fierce gusts swept along the rugged shoreline.  
Raging tides crashed into the weathered cliffs.  
Ominous clouds rolled in from the distant horizon.  
Strong winds howled through the narrow coastal paths.  
Towering waves battered the sandy beaches.  
Yellow lights flickered in the storm's relentless grip.

Cold winds circle a quiet city.  
A lone path climbs past frozen trees.  
Lights mark the road to a lodge.  
Mountains block the flows of fog.

Barefoot boys run through long shadowy alleys.  
Inky clouds drift above cold glowing towers.  
Raindrops tap softly on rusted metal roofs.  
Distant sirens wail with sad lonely cries.  
Silent streets hold breath beneath starless skies.

Walls glow with warm light from golden windows.  
Iron gates hang still along the silent roads.  
Night birds fly past the tall dark towers.  
Distant laughter floats through the cool air.

Silent streets shimmer under soft silver lights.  
Tall towers twist toward the darkened sky.  
Old lampposts outline oaks along the road.  
Rustling wind rises from the river's rim.  
Moons glow as morning moves into view.

Moonlight casts shadows across autumn streets.  
Old buildings glow with warm golden light.  
Unseen birds call from dark park corners.  
Tall clocks mark the slow path to dawn.  
Heavy silence wraps the sleeping city.

Silent stillness wraps soft world around.  
Tiny waves touch warm wet sand gently.  
Owls owl out over open water often.  
Rays rise red reflecting rocks nearby.  
Mist moves moving with morning winds.
